claims: The DS-160 is a U.S. visa application form.
The U.S. B-2 visa is a tourist visa.
Citizens from 40 specific countries can travel to the U.S. for up to 90 days without a visa under the Visa Waiver Program (VWP).
A visa does not guarantee entry.
CBP can deny admission at the port of entry.
Visa application processing fees are non-refundable.
The U.S. Department of State website provides specific country information on entry, exit, and visa requirements for U.S. citizens traveling abroad.
